g.text: MinVelRank5Convo4 begins.
Check boolean MinVelTogether
PapaPolar: hey M, you remember that time we took neci to the ludston museum loool
true
PapaPolar: hey M, you remember that time we took neci to the ludston museum?
false
MomToxicated: Oh Lua, how could I forget?!
MomToxicated: I do. It was... an adventure.
MomToxicated: You were there trying to steal your father's Cold War tooth camera out of their storage facility.
MomToxicated: You were there trying to steal your father's Cold War tooth camera out of their storage facility. Which never happened.
MomToxicated: While I had a 17 year old who was staring at all the ancient statues with the expression of "oh, maybe Paganism."
Probably for the best.
What went wrong?
MomToxicated: While half the staff is ogling her.
MomToxicated: Thank you. He blames me, of course.
MomToxicated: I refused to cause a distraction.
PapaPolar: c'mon don't be so melodramatic.
PapaPolar: she refused to push over a priceless artifact.
PapaPolar: they were ogling you, too.
PapaPolar: i got pa a box of cigars instead. seemed to be just as happy.
Hold up. Cold War?
Wait wait wait. Tooth camera?
What ancient statues?
MomToxicated: C'est la vie.
PapaPolar: yeeeah, so. my pa, Velimir Volkov I?
MomToxicated: The gods of Ancient Kemet. Bastet, Osiris, Ra, Thoth.
+20 Chemistry
PapaPolar: spied for the Rus during the cold war, which was basically when Rus and Libertatia were extremely hostile toward each other
MomToxicated: I could just see the gears turning in her head. "Maybe I'll join a cult."
Chat ends. Next chat will be MinVelRank6Convo1.
PapaPolar: but there wasn't any actual warfare. just threats, propaganda, spying, sabotage, assassinations, things like that
PapaPolar: should've seen the whole scaldra shit coming, now that i think about it in retrospect.
PapaPolar: pa defected to Libertatia, though. 'n here i am.
PapaPolar: um. M?
Why were you after his tooth camera, exactly?
Still stuck on the whole "tooth camera" thing.
MomToxicated: Yes?
PapaPolar: pa wanted it back.
PapaPolar: right. so. say. you're a spy. and you're spying.
PapaPolar: i know it's way too little and it's way too late, and i'll say it in person and i'll say it a thousand more times, but...
PapaPolar: figured it'd be a nice birthday gift.
PapaPolar: and you get caught. with a camera. bad things happen.
PapaPolar: i'm sorry i didn't trust you and your intel on scaldra when i should've. i knew that neci was looking to me for approval to stay or go, and...
... Okay then.
You broke into a major museum to steal his tooth back... for a birthday gift?
PapaPolar: so they got reaaal sneaky about where they could put recording devices.
PapaPolar: my pa never really approved of anything i did, no matter what it was. i didn't want to be like that for her. i wanted to let her make her own choices.
PapaPolar: why? is that not how they do things in the future?
PapaPolar: and pa had this big gold tooth right front 'n center so they stuck an itty bitty camera in it
PapaPolar: but i should've listened. so. i'm sorry.
MomToxicated: We're an odd family, Velimir darling.
PapaPolar: well, itty bitty is relative, it was still a flippin' camera in a tooth
MomToxicated: But you're right. It was her choice to make. And I shouldn't have held her choice against you.
MomToxicated: Sadly, he never did get the camera out from storage.
MomToxicated: And your father did approve of one choice you made.
Probably for the best.
What went wrong?
PapaPolar: oh yeah? what was that?
MomToxicated: Thank you.
MomToxicated: I refused to cause a distraction.
MomToxicated: Marrying me.
PapaPolar: she refused to push over a priceless artifact.
PapaPolar: HAH. that's true. he freaking LOVED you. any woman who can put down vodka shots like he can AND fix a truck in sub-zero weather?! SOLD.
PapaPolar: i got pa a box of cigars instead. seemed to be just as happy.
PapaPolar: sucks we never did get that camera for him out of storage. would've made a great birthday gift for him. oh well.
PapaPolar: worked out in the end. still got a great family vacation out of it.
MomToxicated: Too bad we couldn't go back, just the two of us.
PapaPolar: i could slip Arthur a fifty and pay him to pretend to be a tour guide. we could get drunk and pretend.
MomToxicated: Hah! Oh, the visual there is killing me. But I'll pass.
You two lovebirds have fun. I'm going to go wander off. :)
But what if I want to pay him to be a tour guide?
MomToxicated: You poor thing, having to watch all this sappy nonsense go by. Go on, dear. Be free.
PapaPolar: (i'll float you the cash just for the laugh)
+20 Chemistry
Chat ends. Next chat will be MinVelRank6Convo1.
